newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks up at midday, focus on Multidana.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks up at midday, focus on Multidana.

text.p: Jakarta stocks were higher at midday on Monday, with the market focus on newly-listed financing firm Multidana, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index was up 1.79 points, or 0.27 percent, to 654.27 points by the lunch break. Advancers led decliners by 83 to 57 with 66 issues unchanged.
"Local players appeared to dominate trading, with the focus seen on Multidana which made a surprising debut," one broker said.
